title.rendered: CUBE Consultants Signs Consultancy and Design Contract for Smouha Gate Project in Alexandria

content.rendered:
In Collaboration with Marsoum Developments to Create an Integrated Mixed-Use Urban Destination

Cairo – June 2026
CUBE Consultants has announced the signing of a contract to provide engineering consultancy, urban planning, architectural design, and engineering design services for the Smouha Gate project in Alexandria on behalf of Marsoum Developments. This partnership reflects the confidence of leading real estate developers in CUBE’s expertise, built over more than three decades in the fields of urban planning and design.
Located in one of Alexandria’s prime areas, the Smouha Gate project is envisioned as a comprehensive mixed-use destination featuring residential, commercial, administrative, medical, and entertainment components. The project aims to create a modern urban environment that seamlessly integrates living, working, services, and leisure within a cohesive urban framework.
Under the agreement, CUBE Consultants will be responsible for preparing the project’s urban, architectural, and engineering studies and designs, with a strong focus on implementing the latest principles of sustainability, quality of life, and efficient resource utilization. These efforts will support the project’s vision while enhancing its investment and developmental value.
Dr. Heba Soliman, Chief Executive Officer of CUBE Consultants, stated:
“We are proud of the trust Marsoum Developments has placed in CUBE Consultants by selecting us as the consulting partner for the Smouha Gate project. We look forward to delivering an advanced urban model that reflects the latest global trends in planning and design while achieving a balance between user needs and the project’s investment objectives.”
She added:
“Through this project, we aim to create a fully integrated urban experience centered around people, providing a sustainable, high-quality environment that meets future aspirations and contributes to the ongoing urban development of Alexandria.”
For his part, Eng. Ahmed El-Abbasy, Architectural Design Manager at CUBE Consultants, emphasized that the project represents both a unique design opportunity and an important professional challenge for the team.
He stated:
“The greatest challenge in the Smouha Gate project is achieving a balance between the human-centered requirements of the place and the project’s economic and investment considerations. The success of urban developments is not measured solely by the scale of investment or architectural components, but by their ability to create an integrated human environment that promotes comfort, quality of life, and long-term sustainability.”
He added:
“We seek to develop a design vision that transforms Smouha Gate into a vibrant urban destination characterized by high-quality public spaces, efficient mobility, and integrated activities, delivering maximum value to both users and investors alike.”
This collaboration aligns with CUBE Consultants’ strategy of supporting high-impact urban development projects across Egypt and the region by delivering innovative planning and design solutions that address contemporary challenges and meet the evolving requirements of future cities.

title.rendered: CUBE Consultants Signs Strategic Memorandum of Understanding with Hunan Chamber of Commerce in Egypt to Strengthen Egyptian-Chinese Cooperation

content.rendered:
CUBE Consultants for Engineering and Urban Development has signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Hunan Chamber of Commerce in Egypt (HNCCE) during the Egypt-China Economic and Trade Cooperation Forum and the Chamber’s official launch ceremony in Cairo.

 

The event was attended by a distinguished group of officials and representatives from Egyptian and Chinese economic and investment institutions.

Dr. Heba Soliman, Chief Executive Officer of CUBE Consultants, signed the MoU on behalf of the company as part of CUBE’s ongoing efforts to expand its international partnership network and strengthen cooperation with leading economic and investment organizations worldwide. 

The Memorandum of Understanding aims to establish a shared platform for cooperation and knowledge exchange in the fields of urban planning, architectural design, engineering consultancy, and real estate development. It also seeks to support investment opportunities, foster collaboration in international projects, and facilitate the exchange of technical and professional expertise between both parties. 

Under the agreement, CUBE Consultants will join the network of accredited consulting firms affiliated with the Hunan Chamber of Commerce in Egypt. 

The company will also provide specialized training programs, professional lectures, and technical consultancy services to chamber members and affiliated companies, contributing to enhanced knowledge sharing and professional development between Egypt and China. 

Dr. Heba Soliman emphasized that this partnership represents an important step toward creating new opportunities for cooperation between both sides and reflects CUBE’s strong professional standing as one of the leading firms in urban planning and engineering consultancy in Egypt and the region. 

She added that the company looks forward to leveraging this partnership to support joint development and investment projects, facilitate the transfer of expertise and knowledge, and expand cooperation opportunities in sustainable urban development, smart cities, and infrastructure projects. 

This agreement comes amid the growing relations between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the People’s Republic of China, which continue to witness significant expansion in trade, investment, and development cooperation, further strengthening economic ties between the two countries.

Introducing Opet Studios: The Digital Innovation Arm of Cube Consultants

Cube Consultants is proud to introduce Opet Studios, its dedicated technology and digital innovation arm, established to redefine how architecture, urban development, and real estate projects are experienced in the digital age.

As the industry evolves beyond traditional design and presentation methods, Opet Studios bridges the gap between vision and experience. It focuses on creating immersive, interactive, and intelligent digital solutions that enhance how projects are communicated, understood, and delivered.

Opet Studios specializes in a wide range of advanced digital services, including interactive masterplans, real-time web applications, augmented reality (AR) experiences, and smart visualization tools. These solutions enable clients, investors, and stakeholders to engage with projects in a dynamic and intuitive way—transforming static concepts into living, interactive experiences.

By integrating technology with design, Opet Studios empowers Cube Consultants to deliver not only architectural excellence but also cutting-edge digital innovation. This synergy strengthens Cube’s position as a forward-thinking consultancy capable of shaping both physical environments and digital experiences.

The launch of Opet Studios marks a strategic step toward the future—where architecture meets technology, and ideas are brought to life through interaction, intelligence, and immersive storytelling.

Opet Studios — Powering the digital future of design.

title.rendered: Architecture Video Production & Storytelling: Why It Matters for Design Studios Today

content.rendered:
In a world where audiences consume information visually and instantly, architecture firms can no longer rely solely on still images or static presentations. The depth, emotion, and spatial clarity required to communicate visionary design often demand a medium that can truly bring ideas to life.

Video production has become one of the most powerful tools for architects, bridging imagination with experience and transforming complex concepts into compelling stories. At CUBE, where Spirit Care and Earth Care shape every project, video becomes a natural extension of our philosophy: enabling people to feel the space before it exists.

In this article, we unpack the topic through seven essential questions, each highlighting a core aspect of how video can elevate architectural communication and storytelling.

1. Why should an architecture studio invest in video production?

Objective: To highlight the importance of expanding the medium through which a designer communicates their ideas, articulates their concepts, & showcases their work, beyond just still images or presentations, so that the studio doesn’t lose out on this untapped potential

Video expands the way designers communicate ideas, articulate concepts, and showcase work, beyond the limits of still images or presentations, ensuring the studio doesn’t lose out on this powerful medium.

2. What parameters does the video medium unlock for an architectural studio?

Objective: To explore all the advantages that videos provide, which could be lacking in other modes of presentation. Such as immersive spatial experience, building narratives, layers of audio, tempo, etc.

Videos enable immersive spatial experiences, strong narrative building, layered storytelling, soundscapes, tempo control, and guided emotional pacing, advantages unavailable through other presentation modes. They also allow the designer to direct the viewer’s focus intentionally, highlighting design logic and spatial quality with precision.

3. What is the objective of a video & its role in presenting projects?

Objective: To understand what you should get from producing a video; considering target audience, its duration & overall theme, the kind of message you want to get across, & so on.

A video should be tailored to the audience, duration, overall theme, and the core message you want to convey about the project.

4. Where does your video fit on the “immersive–informative” spectrum?

Objective: To explore both ends of this spectrum, & understand when is it more suitable to lean towards immersiveness, versus being more formal & informative.

Understanding whether a video should lean toward immersive storytelling or formal, informative presentation helps guide tone, pacing, and structure. Defining this balance early ensures clarity, consistency, and impact from the first second to the final frame.

5. How should you organize & plan the framework for the video?

Objective: To elaborate on the importance of setting a very clear guiding concept for the video, & content/requirements needed, or emphasized points, to have an overall coherent video

A strong guiding concept, clear content requirements, and defined emphasis points form the backbone of this architectural video. Proper planning reduces revisions and production time while keeping the video aligned with the architectural narrative.

6. What are storyboards & how do they help the production process?

Objective: To emphasize that planning ahead could be worthwhile & healthy for the video production process

Storyboards visualize the video’s scenes and flow before production begins, making the process more efficient and intentional. They prevent miscommunication between designers, visualizers, and editors by clarifying camera paths, transitions, and narrative beats in advance.

7. What considerations should you keep in mind while producing?

Objective: To go over some technical aspects & reoccurring challenges that we face while taking on a new video for a new project.

Technical aspects, production challenges, must be evaluated from the outset to ensure a smooth workflow. These considerations safeguard quality and ensure the final video remains aligned with the design’s story, project constraints, and client expectations.

Conclusion: Architecture Videos as Strategic Tools for Storytelling & Impact

For architecture studios, video is no longer optional; it is a storytelling necessity that bridges design intent with public understanding, investor interest, and client engagement. When used well, video elevates projects from visual documents into living narratives, revealing the soul and purpose behind each design.

For CUBE, where spaces are conceived as ecosystems of Spirit Care and Earth Care, video becomes a medium of truth, allowing people to experience the sanctuary, vision, and cultural depth embedded in every project long before it is built.

content.rendered:
Administrative buildings are more than offices; they are the engines of nations, institutions, and organizations, shaping how decisions are made, how citizens are served, and how daily operations flow. 

From ancient record halls to today’s smart, climate-responsive complexes, the architecture of admin spaces has evolved into a discipline where efficiency meets identity, and functionality meets human experience.

In this article, we explore, through seven key questions, how administrative buildings developed over centuries, the planning principles that govern them, the environmental and technological drivers reshaping them, and the challenges architects navigate to balance performance, comfort, sustainability, and brand expression. It is a comprehensive look at what it truly takes to design the spaces that keep societies moving.

1. What is the historical development of administrative buildings, and when did they start taking their modern form?

Objective: To understand the historical background and the key milestones that shaped today’s concept of administrative buildings.

Administrative buildings began as the power hubs of ancient civilizations, buzzing temple-palaces in Mesopotamia, record-filled Egyptian complexes, and the versatile Roman basilicas where law, trade, and governance mingled under one roof.

Through the Middle Ages, these spaces evolved into town halls and royal chancelleries that anchored civic identity and growing bureaucracies. But the real transformation came with the rise of modern states: from the 17th to 19th centuries, governments demanded buildings that could organize armies of clerks, safeguard archives, and project authority.

By the early 20th century, steel frames, elevators, and the clean lines of modernism reshaped these once ceremonial spaces into efficient, purpose-built administrative machines, essentially the blueprint for the government and corporate office buildings we recognize today.

2. What are the essential internal requirements for any administrative building in terms of spatial layout and functional distribution?

Objective: To clarify planning fundamentals such as the distribution of offices, meeting rooms, circulation, and support spaces.

Essential internal requirements for an administrative building hinge on creating a clear, efficient spatial hierarchy that supports daily operations. Offices are typically arranged according to privacy and workflow needs, public-facing units near entrances, general workspaces in central areas, and executive offices in quieter zones.

Meeting rooms of various sizes are distributed throughout to support collaboration, ideally placed near departmental clusters for easy access. Circulation must be intuitive, with primary corridors and vertical movement (stairs, elevators) forming a legible spine that minimizes travel time and prevents congestion.

Support spaces, such as reception areas, storage rooms, printing zones, IT/server rooms, restrooms, and staff break areas, are strategically placed to remain accessible but unobtrusive. Overall, the layout balances openness and privacy, ensures smooth movement, and creates a functional ecosystem where each space reinforces administrative efficiency.

Behind this smooth experience lies a network of essential support and MEP spaces that strengthen functionality: dedicated mechanical rooms for HVAC equipment, electrical rooms for panels and backup systems, data/telecom rooms connected to trunk lines, fire pump and sprinkler control rooms, janitor/cleaning closets with service sinks, and waste-handling rooms for safe collection and disposal.

Together, these spatial and MEP components create an organized, efficient environment where administrative processes can operate smoothly and reliably.

3. What are the main requirements for creating a comfortable and productive work environment inside administrative buildings?

Objective: To explore workplace factors like lighting, ventilation, acoustics, privacy, and shared spaces and how they impact employee productivity.

A comfortable and productive administrative workspace depends on a blend of environmental quality and thoughtful workplace design. Good lighting, especially natural light supplemented with well-balanced artificial illumination, boosts focus and reduces fatigue.

Effective ventilation and thermal control keep the air fresh and temperatures stable, directly influencing alertness and comfort. Strong acoustic design helps limit noise from open offices, corridors, and equipment, preserving concentration. Privacy is supported through layout choices, such as buffered zones, meeting rooms, and semi-enclosed workstations that allow employees to focus without feeling isolated.

Finally, well-designed shared spaces, break rooms, lounges, collaboration areas, and quiet zones encourage interaction, reduce stress, and support varied work styles. Together, these factors create an environment where staff can think clearly, communicate easily, and perform at their best.

4. How has modern technology influenced the design and operation of administrative buildings? And what are the key smart systems used today?

Objective: To examine the role of technology in smart building management, security, energy efficiency, and integration with modern work systems.

Modern technology has turned administrative buildings into lively, intuitive spaces that practically run themselves. Smart Building Management Systems use webs of IoT sensors to sense when people arrive, adjust lighting, fine-tune the AC, and cut energy use without drawing attention.

Even the windows have gotten smarter: AI-driven automated shading systems track sunlight, temperature, and glare throughout the day, adjusting blinds in real time to keep spaces bright but comfortable. Security is smoother too, with biometric doors and AI-assisted cameras quietly safeguarding the building.

Add in fast connectivity, cloud platforms, smart elevators, and energy dashboards, and administrative buildings start to feel less like static workplaces and more like helpful partners, always comfortable, secure, and one step ahead.

5. What standards and building codes must architects follow when designing administrative buildings, especially concerning safety and sustainability?

 Objective: To highlight the importance of compliance with planning regulations, emergency requirements, sustainability standards, and accessibility.

Architects designing administrative buildings must navigate a framework of safety, sustainability, and accessibility standards that shape everything from floor layouts to material choices. Building codes typically require strict compliance with life-safety regulations, including fire-resistant materials, protected escape routes, emergency lighting, fire alarms, and sprinkler systems (often guided by standards such as the International Building Code (IBC) and NFPA rules).

Planning regulations dictate site use, building heights, setbacks, and parking, ensuring the project fits safely and legally within its urban context. To ensure accessibility, architects follow guidelines such as the ADA Standards for Accessible Design, covering ramps, elevators, door widths, tactile signage, and inclusive restroom layouts.

Sustainability is equally crucial, with many administrative buildings designed to meet LEED, BREEAM, or similar green-building standards that promote energy efficiency, healthy indoor environments, and responsible material use. Together, these codes and certifications ensure that administrative buildings are safe, environmentally responsible, and accessible to all users.

6. What are the main challenges architects face when designing an administrative building compared to other building types?
 

Objective: To identify design challenges such as future flexibility, user density, cost management, and space efficiency.

Designing an administrative building brings a set of challenges that go beyond those of most other building types, pushing architects to juggle efficiency, adaptability, and performance. One of the biggest hurdles is future flexibility; the building must be planned to handle shifting staff sizes, new technologies, and evolving workplace models without major disruptions.

High user density demands layouts that keep circulation smooth and prevent bottlenecks, while still offering enough quiet and collaborative areas. Cost management adds pressure, as clients expect durable finishes and smart systems without overspending. Maximizing space efficiency is essential too, fitting offices, meeting rooms, support spaces, and MEP zones into a compact yet comfortable footprint. On top of that, architects face the challenge of administrative building massing and modeling: these projects often require large, block-like volumes that must remain visually appealing, contextually appropriate, and environmentally responsive.

Achieving a balanced massing form, one that brings in daylight, supports energy efficiency, and respects site constraints, can be far more demanding than in smaller or more sculptural building types. Combined, these factors make administrative buildings some of the most complex and strategically driven projects architects design.

7. How does the design of the building’s façade contribute to the company’s identity and branding? And what elements should be considered to balance aesthetics and functionality?

 Objective: To explain how the façade acts as a visual representation of the brand while maintaining functional performance.

The façade of an administrative building is a powerful tool for shaping how a company, or institution, is perceived, because it instantly communicates identity, purpose, and values. In corporate headquarters, sleek glass skins or dynamic geometric patterns project innovation, ambition, and modernity, reinforcing a forward-thinking brand. In government or public administrative buildings, more solid, monumental façades with stone or concrete convey stability, authority, and trust.

For educational or institutional administration, warm materials and open, transparent façades suggest accessibility, community, and collaboration. At the same time, this expressive power must work in hand with functionality. Architects carefully consider solar control, insulation, glare reduction, daylighting, acoustic performance, and maintenance to ensure the façade performs efficiently year-round.

Elements like smart glazing, shading fins, double-skin systems, and optimal window-to-wall ratios help merge beauty with performance. Ultimately, the façade becomes the building’s “character”, a visual story that strengthens brand identity while meeting the technical demands of comfort, sustainability, and long-term durability.

 Administrative buildings may appear simple at first glance, but behind every corridor, façade line, meeting room, and service core lies a complex interplay of history, regulation, technology, human needs, and organizational strategy. As cities grow smarter and institutions evolve, these spaces must become more adaptable, more efficient, and more humane.

Designing them is an act of shaping how people work, collaborate, and lead. For architects, the true challenge and opportunity lie in creating administrative environments that are resilient, sustainable, future-proof, and deeply aligned with the identity of the institutions they serve.

At CUBE, we believe admin spaces are ecosystems, and when designed with intent, they elevate well-being, productivity, and the very quality of governance.

 

Eng. Ahmed Amin

Team Leader, Design Architect

title.rendered: Lujain Resort, Salalah: Designing a Water-Led Urban Ecosystem in Oman

content.rendered:
A technical deep-dive into the 3.6 million m² waterfront masterplan

Introduction: Beyond a Resort—A Fluid Urban Ecosystem

Lujain Resort in Salalah is not simply a luxury coastal destination; it is a water-driven, climate-responsive urban ecosystem designed across 3,632,109 m². The masterplan integrates 20+ villa typologies, 3,000+ apartments, 1,000 hotel keys, a 2 km marina promenade, and 1,000,000 m² of lagoon networks—creating a living environment where hydrology, mobility, and form-generation operate as one system.

1. Site Intelligence: Designing for Khareef Climate

Salalah’s microclimate—cool monsoon winds, elevated humidity cycles, and seasonal greenery—directly shaped the project’s environmental strategy.

Key Technical Parameters

  • Prevailing winds: South–Southwest → informs natural ventilation corridors
  • Solar exposure: Optimized through sloped roofs & strategic massing
  • Environmental loads: Managed through passive cooling + water networks
  • Topography: Gently sloped, enabling gravity-fed lagoon extension

Insight:
The project leverages Salalah’s climatic advantage by extending the ocean inland, creating a temperature-buffering lagoon system that reduces thermal storage and improves microclimate by 3–5°C in peak months.

2. Water as Form Generator: Lagoon Morphology & Urban Hydrology

The central design premise:

“Extend the ocean into the land—make water the spine of the masterplan.”

Hydrological System Highlights

  • 1,000,000 m² lagoon system engineered as a closed-loop water body
  • Distributed filtration nodes to maintain self-cleaning cycles
  • Controlled water levels through smart gates and retention zones
  • Overflow channels designed for monsoon peaks

Urban Impact

  • 77% of all villas enjoy direct or semi-direct water frontage
  • Hotels positioned as hydro-anchors overlooking the infinity edge
  • Cooling breezes channelled through lagoon corridors
  • Increased land value through expanded waterfront edge geometry

This hydrological-first approach is what elevates Lujain from a “resort” into a water-urbanism prototype.

 

3. Lujain’s functions: Zoning & architectural program.

The resort provides a comprehensive program revolved around the infused water lagoon, divided into two zones:

1. Public Zone (22.5% of Lujain)

  • Downtown mixed-use blocks
  • City Center mall & exhibitions
  • 2 km Marina Walk
  • Downtown hotel

Technical Note:
The urban blocks follow 40% footprint + 1 FAR, allowing mid-density, walkable commercial districts without overwhelming the waterfront.

2. Private Islands Zone (77.5% of Lujain)

  • Residential Apartments
  • Mosque & Services center
  • Falling Water Hotel
  • Lujain Islands
  • Central Islands
  • Palace Islands (personal islands)

These are shaped following 360° shoreline maximization geometry, using fractal-like edges to increase sellable premium plots.

 

4. Architectural Language: Modern Omani Identity

Across villas, apartments, hotels, and mixed-use blocks, Lujain shares the vocabulary rooted in Omani vernacular sustainability.

Key Elements

  • Arches: Structural and shading function
  • Sloped roofs: Rain management + reduced heat gain
  • Wind towers: Passive cooling intake system
  • Solar panels: Integrated renewable strategy

Why It Works

Instead of importing a foreign design identity, the project uses regional morphology while maintaining contemporary proportions and materials.
This fusion supports both cultural resonance and environmental performance.

5. Residential Architecture: Typology Engineering at Scale

The project includes:

Villas

  • 10+ standalone villa types
  • Twin villas
  • Townhouses
  • Private island palaces
  • Plot sizes: 600–4,000 m²
  • BUA: 120–600 m²

Apartments

  • 1, 2, 3 bedrooms + duplexes
  • 70–200 m² units
  • 3-floor max height for waterfront blocks

Highlight:
Unit distribution follows a 75% sellable efficiency on islands, taking into account setbacks, canal edges, and private beach allocations.

6. Hotels as anchoring design elements (1,130 Keys)

The hotels are arranged as landmarks but also as environmental regulators.

Falling Water Hotel

A sculptural hotel embedded within the lagoon system, functioning as:

  • A heat-sink moderating canal temperatures
  • A microclimate generator
  • An iconic silhouette for the resort’s identity

Beach Hotel

Placed at the site’s natural ocean interface to:

  • Create a gateway vista
  • Capture prevailing breezes
  • Anchor the beachfront experience

 

7. Circulation: Walkable Downtown

Key Circulation Principles

  • Car movement restricted to arterial loops
  • Internal island circulation via e-buggies, carts, and shaded walkways
  • 30 m marina promenade designed for retail, F&B, and public life
  • Distributed parking hubs (2,500-car downtown lot)

The circulation system supports a slow-city philosophy, prioritizing human comfort over vehicle throughput.

8. Sustainability Framework

Beyond aesthetics, sustainability is embedded through:

Passive Systems

  • Wind towers
  • North–South villa orientation
  • Shaded arcades
  • Water-based cooling corridors

Active Systems

  • Solar farms (3.1% of land area)
  • Hybrid sewage treatment
  • Smart lighting & grid management

Urban Ecology

  • 27.5% dedicated to lakes and water features
  • 30–70% landscaped open space, depending on zone
  • Biodiversity corridors linking lagoons to green buffers

This creates a self-sustaining resort-urban district.

 

Conclusion: A New Model for Gulf Coastal Urbanism

Lujain Resort is a technical showcase of how water, climate, culture, and luxury can merge into a coherent architectural ecosystem. With its integrated hydrology, Omani-rooted architectural language, and sustainable eco-tourism, the project stands as a regional benchmark for waterfront cities in the GCC.

In a shared commitment to shaping future-ready designers, Cube Consultants and the Information Technology Institute (ITI) launched a multi-phase collaboration that connects academic exploration with the realities of architectural practice. The first phase centered on knowledge exchange through a focused session exploring how design and technology intersect in today’s built environment. Students were introduced to contemporary approaches — from computational tools to AI-integrated processes — gaining insights into the evolving nature of architectural workflows and the importance of critical, systems-based thinking.

The second phase brought students into our workspace for a full-day mentorship immersion. Far from a passive visit, the experience was hands-on and collaborative. Students presented early concepts, digital studies, and conceptual prototypes, receiving real-time feedback from professionals across disciplines. These dialogues focused on narrative clarity, design refinement, and workflow efficiency — offering a candid look into how ideas mature within a studio environment. It was an exchange that emphasized learning through doing, and growing through conversation.

In the final phase, Cube Consultants joined the academic jury for a comprehensive project review, evaluating a wide spectrum of student work — from urban-scale strategies to tech-enhanced visualizations. The review emphasized constructive critique over scoring, highlighting strengths, challenging assumptions, and encouraging students to push creative boundaries. It was an opportunity to support growth not only through recognition, but through questions that inspire deeper thinking.

Through every phase, this collaboration underscored a core belief: mentorship is not an add-on to practice, but a vital responsibility. At Cube Consultants, we view mentorship as a space where ideas are tested, talents are nurtured, and the future of design is shaped — one conversation, one challenge, and one breakthrough at a time.

content.rendered:
Cube Consultants Part of the Launch Event of “Nebu” by GEDICO Developments in the New Administrative Capital

Cube Consultants was honored to be a part in the official launch event of Nebu, a flagship development by GEDICO Developments, held in Egypt’s New Administrative Capital. The event, organized by GEDICO, brought together key figures from the real estate and design sectors to unveil this landmark project and celebrate the vision behind it.

The name “Nebu” is rooted in ancient Egyptian culture, meaning gold — a symbol of wealth, eternity, and divine power. Historically associated with the gods and the afterlife, gold represented purity and immortality. In today’s context, the name Nebu evokes a sense of luxury, heritage, and timelessness — qualities that are deeply embedded in the project’s architectural identity and brand philosophy.

Cube Consultants was engaged as a design partner on this prestigious project, collaborating with GEDICO Developments to craft a modern and integrated urban environment that reflects both cultural depth and contemporary needs. Our team contributed to the executive design of the project, ensuring that its architectural language aligns with the values of elegance, efficiency, and sustainability.

During the event, Cube Consultants’ Executive Design Manager delivered a speech highlighting the collaborative journey between the two companies. The speech emphasized the design vision behind Nebu, the challenges and opportunities of building within the New Capital, and the shared goal of setting new benchmarks in architectural excellence. It was a proud moment that reaffirmed our role not just as designers, but as long-term partners in shaping meaningful and iconic developments.

The launch event provided an engaging platform to connect with fellow industry leaders and celebrate a project that aspires to redefine mixed-use urban development in Egypt, Nebu is poised to become a cornerstone of the New Capital’s architectural and cultural landscape.

Cube Consultants looks forward to the continued progress of this visionary project and to supporting GEDICO Developments in bringing Nebu to life with the highest standards of design and execution.

content.rendered:
The METATUT: a Metaverse Inspired By King Tutankhamun

The first Egyptian city in a virtual world was developed by the Cairo-based platform TUTERA

By Paromita Gupta

Opinions expressed by Entrepreneur contributors are their own.
You’re reading Entrepreneur India, an international franchise of Entrepreneur Media.
Instead of exploring space and robotics, what if there was a way to go back in time and explore ancient cultures?
TUTERA, a bootstrapped creative community hub for designers, aims at reviving ancient Egyptian history with the help of conceptual designs. Earlier last week, the company announced its METATUT CITY.
The city is said to be inspired by King Tutankhamun and is developed to mark the 100th anniversary of discovering the youngest Egyptian pharaoh’s tomb.
Why is it the first Egyptian city in the virtual world? “Because after the 100-year anniversary of the discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb, we thought of establishing a platform that enables people to visit and interact. They can interact by watching the ancient Egyptian civilization, listening to historical stories and touring the city”, told Dr Somaya Bahy Eldin, Vice-president, TUTERA to Reuters, a British news agency.
On Monday, Reuters also shared a glimpse of the metaverse.
Inspired by ancient Egypt, the company TUTERA debuted METATUT, the first Egyptian virtual city in the Metaverse https://t.co/UrOPgGQ9xl">pic.twitter.com/UrOPgGQ9xl

— Reuters (@Reuters) https://twitter.com/Reuters/status/1602043041186881537?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw">December 11, 2022
Users will be able to travel through time and space and learn about the history of civilization. The current spaces open to visitors in the metaverse are Valley of the Kings, Sun Chamber, Akhenaten Palace, and the magic melody chamber. The Akhenaten Palace will let visitors experience his journey and will be divided into four stages; Egyptian Gods Path, Transition Area, Land of No Where, and The Immortal Love Hall.
METATUT’s phase I is being launched with four portals; Amarna- the Hall of the Sun, The Enchanted Melody Hall, Nefertiti Palace, and Avenue of the Kings. The company plans to open other spaces by December-end.
The metaverse can be experienced by using virtual reality headgears, through your desktops and phones. If a great civilization comes back to life and completes its architectural and cultural projects in the 21st century, what will it look like?

عالم الميتافرس  METVERSE

يدخل المستخدم إلى هذا العالم ليجد نفسه داخل سلسلة من المجتمعات الافتراضية المترابطة والتي لا نهاية لها، يمكنه من خلالها التقاء عدد كبير من الناس المتاح التعامل معهم إما للعمل أواللعب، كل ما يحتاجه لذلك سماعات الواقع الافتراضي ونظارات الواقع المعزز وما ترتبط به من تطبيقات الهواتف الذكية.
لن تقتصر الاستفادة من ميتافيرس على ممارسة الألعاب أو حتى عقد اجتماعات العمل بشكل افتراضي، بل ستتأثر جميع الأنشطة التي يمارسها مستخدم الإنترنت بهذا العالم، فعلى سبيل المثال سيشهد التسوق الإلكتروني نقلة نوعية داخل هذا العالم، حيث يكون المستخدم قادرا على معاينة أي شيء يريد شرائه عن قرب بدلا من مجرد معاينة صور في الشكل التقليدي المعروف الآن للمتاجر الإلكترونية.
مع تطور عوالم ميتافيرس سيصبح كل نشاط إنساني في الواقع الحقيقي متاحا بكل تفاصيله في العالم الافتراضي، الأمر الذي يعني أن الإنسان ربما يكون قادرا على البقاء في العالم الافتراضي لفترات أطول، فهو إما مسترخيا في منزله الافتراضي أو يمارس إحدى الألعاب أو الرياضات مع أصدقاء من مختلف أنحاء العالم، أو يعقد اجتماعات افتراضية أو يتسوق ما يحتاجه من متاجر على الجانب الآخر من الكوكب.
أطلقت شركة فيسبوك (ميتا حاليا) تطبيقا للاجتماعات الافتراضية للشركات، يسمى Horizon Workrooms، يحتاج مستخدميه لنظارات الواقع الافتراضي Oculus quest 2، وحتى الآن لم تحظ هذه النظارات بالرضا الكامل من المستخدمين، فضلا عن ارتفاع سعرها الذي يبلغ 300 دولار أو أكثر، مما يجعل معظم تجارب ميتافيرس المتطورة بعيدا عن متناول الكثيرين خاصة في الدول النامية.
تقوم الفكرة الأساسية لميتافيرس على تحرير الثقافات ومزجها ببعض عن طريق تفاعل سهل وسريع بين سكان القارات المختلفة، ما يعني سهولة أكبر لاطلاع المستخدمين العاديين على بيانات أكبر للمستخدمين الآخرين، فالأمر لن يقف عند حد الاطلاع على البيانات الشخصية والصور فقط، بل ستكون تفاصيل الحياة في العالم الافتراضي، والتي تحاكي الواقع، متاحة للجميع.
فيمكن تخيل كيف للمستخدم أن يكشف عن اهتماماته بسهولة للمحيطين به ما بين اهتمامات فنية أو رياضية أو تسوقية، فضلا عن تفاعلاته الشخصية وربما قراراته اليومية بدأ من اختيار قائمة تشغيل أغاني معينة وحتى قرارات الارتباط وتكوين أسرة.

هل التكنولوجيا موجودة بالفعل؟

شهدت تكنولوجيا الواقع الافتراضي تطوراً كبيراً في الأعوام الأخيرة، حيث ابتُكرت نظارات باهظة الثمن بإمكانها خداع العين البشرية وجعلها ترى الأشياء بالأبعاد الثلاثية، بينما يتنقل اللاعب في العالم الافتراضي. كما أصبحت أكثر شيوعاً – فقد كانت نظارة “أوكيولاس كويست-2” التي تستخدم في ألعاب الواقع الافتراضي من بين الهدايا الرائجة خلال أعياد الميلاد في 2020.
وربما يشير تفجر الاهتمام بتقنية التشفير “إن.إف.تي”، التي قد تزودنا بوسيلة موثوقة لتتبع ملكية السلع الرقمية، إلى الكيفية التي سيعمل بها الاقتصاد الافتراضي في المستقبل.
والعوامل الرقمية الأكثر تطوراً سوف تكون بحاجة إلى اتصالية أكثر جودة واتساقاً وقابلية للتنقل – وهو شيء ربما يتحقق مع توسيع نطاق تقنية ال 5 جي.
حالياً، لا يزال كل شيء في مراحله الأولى. وتطور الميتافيرس – إذا حدث من الأصل، سوف يكون شيئاً تتصارع عليه شركات التكنولوجيا العملاقة على مدى العقود القادمة، وربما لأبعد من ذلك.
لم يستطع فريق ميتاتوت تحقيق امكانية التجول فى المدينة بالكامل باستخدام برامج الألعاب الالكترونية لعدم التوصل التكنولوجيا حتى الآن بذلك فلجأ فريق ميتاتوت لحل وسط مرحليا من خلال استخدام منصة SPECIAL  لعرض فراغات المدينة الريسية كل على حده من خلال بوابات انتقال او سفر من مكان لآخر
 

رؤية المدينة:  

تعتمد فكرة المدينة على إفتراض تخيلى بعودة الملك توتعنخآمون  عام 2022 ليستكمل ماكان يحلم به لوطنه من خلال العالم الافتراضى وباستخدام تكنولوجيا العصر المتاحة يستطيع مساعدة شعبه لاكتشاف ماوراء الحضارة المصرية القديمة فى صورة عصرية حديثة. وبداية قرر إنشاء مدينة ميتاتوت التخيلية لتحقيق مالم يمكن تحقيقه فى العالم الحقيقى، فيسافر زائر المدينة فى رحلة عبر الزمان والمكان،

ومن هنا جاءت فكرة انشاء مدينة توتيرا فى عالم الميتافيرس الإفتراضى بشكل مختلف ومتنوع وحر،  مدينة افتراضية يعيش زوارها وسكانها تجربة فريدة تدمج بين الحضارة المصرية بشكل عصرى وبين حضاره تخيلية للمستقبل، يمارس بها السكان أو الزائرين كافة مجالات الحياة سواء السكن، الترفيه، التجارة، التعليم، وكافة الأعمال، ليس فقط مجالات الحياة العادية ولكن مجالات مستحدثة للعالم التخيلى .

تبدأ التجربة لتكون استكشافية لهذا العالم وتلك المدينة، بهدف استكشاف كل ركن من أركان البيئة والتفاعل مع المشاهد، والتواصل الاجتماعي مع الزوار الآخرين وممارسة الأعمال التجارية من خلال معارض تجارية للعلامات التجارية، أو أماكن لعقد اجتماعات ، ورش عمل، محاضرات، حفلات وغيره كمرحلة أولى.

على أن يشارك الزوار فى نمو المدينة من خلال شراء أماكن أو أراضى لبناء مستقراتهم طبقا لكود المدينة بمراحلها اللاحقة.

content.rendered:
The term “metaverse” refers to an immersive, social, and hyper realistic virtual setting where individuals will have the opportunity to interact while using 3D customized avatars.
In his science fiction book “Snow Crash,” which was published in 1992, author Neal Stephenson introduced the term.
The book relates the tale of “Hiro Protagonist,” a figure who, while a pizza delivery kid in real life, is a samurai in the fictional metaverse.
The concept is for the metaverse to have its own virtual economy and for individuals to be able to work, own houses, purchase items for their wardrobes, attend events, have meetings, and genuinely live online.
As companies compete to create platforms that will attract users to their own regions of the metaverse, virtual environments are becoming more common and more sophisticated, for platforms like Spatial.io, Microsoft Mesh and Facebook’s Horizon Worlds, metaverse feels like an extension of work or life, where avatars can meet in bright modern environments or supernatural encounter landscapes.
Meanwhile, mega-platforms like The Sims, Minecraft, Second Life and Roblox have been building expansive and immersive virtual worlds for years, allowing players to build their own structures and explore these ever-expanding landscapes.
People will no longer navigate a single metaverse; rather, they will travel across a number of connected metaverses that can communicate with one another in a huge digital environment. These metaverses will all be supported by the blockchain and on-platform currencies that drive their meta-economies.
For many years, the built environment was mostly shaped by architects, engineers, and builders. Because the physical world is so complex, it needs safeguards like rules, zoning, accreditations, and best – practice. There are rational reasons why not everyone is capable of constructing a skyscraper.
Real architecture differs from a metaverse in certain ways. The characteristics of the location itself make the biggest difference, Additionally, there won’t be any real-world rules or restrictions in the metaverse, such as gravity, construction stability, climate challenges, or physical laws. However, in a virtual environment, every location has a purpose or a storyline. Therefore, architects are free to overcome the constraints at hand and produce remarkable surroundings and genuine works of art.
Last but not least, despite the fact that in modern architecture visualizations are created to show potential customers the atmosphere and features of a space before construction begins, in the metaverse the entire environment is created with the same amount of time and effort that is put into visualization.
It is clear that architects contribute a significant amount to the implementation of creative environment in the metaverse. In order to construct or improve these spaces, architects and designers are required since people need places to interact within in the metaverse.
However, as this new world expands, our perspective of what characterizes an architect may modify. It’s possible that as time goes on, the terms “architect” and “meta-architect” will become separate due to the
change in architecture’s goals. While traditional architecture is essential for enabling our daily activities and providing shelter, meta-architects will focus exclusively on form, geometry, and visuals.
Architects designing for the metaverse might need to develop new skills and change their perspective. In the metaverse, architects must perform the 3dmodeling and include expert knowledge from several disciplines, such as user interface, content, character, and even game design. And this will allow a greater number of individuals to access to the realm of architecture. The process of creating this cutting-edge architectural design will include more people.
In addition, this new generation of architects will require guidance in a combination of digital media and 3D technologies. This results in a change that goes beyond the development of architecture, building methods, and materials.
Finally, in the metaverse, the entire environment is developed with the same amount of time and effort that is spent simply on visualization, whereas in present architecture, visualizations are created to communicate the mood and details of the space to the audience before the creation.
Metaverse is regarded as both beneficial and detrimental for architects. For instance, a digital twin of an actual project can be created in the virtual environment of the metaverse in which clients have the authority to live there for a month to see if they enjoy the space before building it.
Design companies in the realm of the virtual world
Zaha Hadid Architects
Zaha Hadid Architects have recently collaborated with PUBG Mobile to create a virtual environment where players worldwide can experience an interactive entertainment experience. It is a realm where up to 100 individuals defeat other players in an aesthetically and technically rich battleground.
ILLUSORR
ILLUSORR is a design-oriented metaverse that merges the physical and virtual worlds to create original environments and experiences. It aims to redefine the once fragmented virtual reality business as an all-in-one platform that provides corporations, creatives, and individuals with a completely immersive metaverse experience.
Decentral and Architects
Decentral and Architects is a blockchain virtual world founded in March 2021. They provide 3d design and architecture for customers to build and develop professional virtual real estate. Users can use the in-game cryptocurrency Mana to buy parcels and plots of land and spend their time in an immersive environment.
We at Cube Consultants believe it’s important to stay on top of new technologies and global trends. For the past 18 months, we have been working on building a metaverse city across several platforms. new technologies can offer limited capabilities, our most recent efforts have been focused on spatial.io, a platform that allows users to experience cutting-edge designs without being constrained by physical constraints or barriers.
Under the direct guidance of Dr. Ashraf Abdel Mohsen, we assigned a collaborative team and freelancers with various backgrounds, abilities, and mindsets in order to build the ideal team required to create exceptional environments and exquisite experiences.
All of the experiences we offer are primarily intended to represent modern-day ancient Egyptian civilization while also envisioning its influences on our current culture and way of life.
We not only make sure that everyone participating in the new experience will find it fascinating, regardless of their culture or religion, but we also create a welcoming community in which everyone may come together.
Spatial.io platform was a perfect choice as it enables not only PC users to enter the metaverse world, but it provides access to the same experience to people who has either an Oculus VR headset or even just a mobile.
After taking everything into account, the way the spaces are designed will strongly influence how we imagine our future home, the metaverse. As a result, it appears that architects will lead the metaverse by offering extremely desirable space features to its many users.
The Metaverse’s buildings are computer-generated, yet they were inspired by traditional structures in their design. More and more designers and architects will seek out opportunities in virtual landscapes as the world and the architectural environment around us change, creating digital assets with the same passion, vision, and consideration that we see in the designs surrounding us on Earth.
 
 
Architect / Khaled Radwan
Architect / Mazen Nabil
CUBE Consultants

Recently, the New Administrative Capital witnessed the offering of plots of land to investors, and the Cube design team presented different architectural designs, including 3 projects of different uses for distinguished real estate developers, and they are now going through the final finishing stages in 2022.

residential compound project on an area of ​​45 acres 
An administrative building project on an area of ​​. 5,836 m2 
An international school project on an area of ​​25,000 m2 –

Boardwalk

بورد ووك مجمع سكني – Boardwalk

 R7 يقع المشروع في وسط 
وهي واحدة من أكثر المناطق تميزًا على بعد دقائق من أشهر وأهم معالم العاصمة الإدارية الجديدة بالقرب من الحي الدبلوماسي ومدينة المعارض والمدينة الطبية والنهر الأخضر
تم تطبيق المبادىء الرئيسية لتخطيط العاصمة في تصميم المشروع, حيث يتميز التصميم بالاستدامة ويتوافر به جميع الخدمات الذكية اللازمة للسكان ويحتوى على مول تجاري ومواقف سيارات تحت الأرض مؤمنة بالكامل و منطقة مطاعم ومسارات للمشي وركوب الدراجات، وحمامات سباحة داخل الكمبوند و نظام الطاقة الشمسية يغطي كافة اسطح المباني من أجل الاعتماد على مصدر آمن للطاقة المتجددة
 
لمزيد من التفاصيل حول المشروع يمكن زيارة الرابط المرفق
https://cubeconsultants.org/portfolio/boardwalk-2/

Kemet Tower

برج كيميت – Kemet Tower

يقع المبنى الادراي في قلب المرحلة الاولى من العاصمة بحى المال والأعمال ، وبجوار البنك المركزي ومحطة القطارات الرئيسية. يقام المشروع على مساحة 5،836 م2 ويجرى الانتهاء من تنفيذه حاليا
كان الهدف الرئيسي من التصميم هو تزويد المبنى الإداري برسالة قوية   ورمزية تمثل جوهر مصر القديمة مستمدة من فكرة “توتيرا  “TUTERA, والتي تهدف إلى محاكاة تطور الحضارة المصرية القديمة والتفكير المستقبلي في التصميمات الحديثة. تم الوصول لهذا التصميم من خلال الإلهام من الرموز المميزة لدلتا النيل والأهرامات العظيمة التي طبقت خصائصها على التصميم بطريقة معاصرة
تم تصميم المبنى مما يسمح بتعامد لأشعة الشمس يوميا داخل بهو المبنى الرئيسى عبر التجويف الهرمى هرم للمبنى ليجسد العلاقة بين السماء والأرض، ويحاكى البهو الرئيسى للبرج بارتفاع 35 مترً تشكيل البهو العظيم لهرم الملك خوفو
لمزيد من التفاصيل حول المشروع يمكن زيارة الرابط المرفق

Sahara International School

مدرسة صحارا الدولية   – Sahara International School   

المشروع  يقام على مساحة 25 الف متر مربع ويقع على الطريق الرئيسي المتصل بمحور محمد بن زايد في قلب منطقة الواحة التي تضم جميع الخدمات بالحي السكني الثالث المتصل مباشرا بالنهر الاخضر
يهدف تصميم المشروع الى خلق بيئة تعليمية مناسبة تساعد الطلاب في الابداع من خلال تطبيق أيديولوجية جديدة من شأنها أن تضمن أقصى فائدة للمجتمع التعليمي.  حيث جاءت رؤية تصميم المشروع مستمدة من المبادئ الاساسية السبعة لتخطيط العاصمة الادارية الجديدة بهدف ان تكون مستدامة وخضراء وصديقة للبيئة . 60% من مساحة المدرسة مسطحات خضراء مفتوحة متصلة مباشرة بالواحة, كما تغطى اسطح المبنى بالكامل الواح الطاقة الشمسية ويغطى الحرم الجامعي بالكامل بشبكة المعلومات الرقمية الذكية بالاضافة الى ميكنة جميع الأنشطة المدرسية
تم تصميم الواجهة الملونة للمدرسة كشكل من أشكال المساعدة التعليمية للطلاب وتصميم جميع واجهات المبنى يساعد على اختراق أشعة الشمس المباشرة لجميع الفصول الدراسية وتعديل نظام التهوية

Our company always seeks to participate in preparing multiple future visions in Egypt. Recently, the Cube design team presented ideas for proposed projects for specialized and precise scientific research centers for astronomy and space tourism through 3 projects that won awards in international competitions.

TUTERA CITY

TUTERA CITY مدينة توتيرا لسياحة الفضاء وعلوم الفلك

تقوم الفكرة حول بناء أول مدينة أبحاث علمية متخصصة فى علوم الفلك وسياحة الفضاء على أرض “مصر” تُخصص تطبيقاتها في مجال السياحة عبر حدود الزمان والمكان، والمدينة بالكامل داخل بناء هرمى يبلغ حجمه أربعة أضعاف حجم هرم الملك خوفو بالجيزة، مدينة تطبق العلوم والتقنيات الذكية لتوفر الراحة لمستخدميها وتكون مكتفية ذاتيا” من الطاقة والمياه
فكرة المشروع مستوحاه من الحضارة المصرية القديمة بشكل عصرى  (توتيرا)
لمزيد من التفاصيل حول المدينة يمكن زيارة الروابط المرفقة
https://cubeconsultants.org/tutera-city/
https://cubeconsultants.org/portfolio/tutera-city/

Rethinking the Future 2021- First Award | Mixed Use (Concept)

UFO

UFO مدينة الصحراء لسياحة الفضاء (المركبة الفضائية)

تقوم الفكرة حول تصميم مدينة صحراوية لمنصات اطلاق المركبات الفضائية لسياحة واكتشاف الفضاء وتقوم على مراكز أبحاث علمية متخصصة فى علوم الفضاء وتحتوى المدينة عدد 12 منصة إطلاق ومنطقة سكنية للعلماء والزوار ومدينة بحثية داخل مبنى على شكل المركبات الفضائية UFO  والعديد من الأنشطة التعليمية والصحية والترفيهية، مدينة تطبق العلوم والتقنيات الذكية لتوفر الراحة لمستخدميها وتكون مكتفية ذاتيا” من الطاقة والمياه، فكرة المشروع مستوحاه من المركبات الفضائية
لمزيد من التفاصيل حول المدينة يمكن زيارة الروابط المرفقة

(Gold Winner) Global Future Design Awards 2022 
http://www.architecturepressrelease.com/gold-winner-ufo-cube-consultants/

A'ARU 1.0

A’ARU 1.0 القرية الفضائية المدارية 

تدور الفكرة حول إنشاء مستعمرة قابلة للتوسع في الفضاء وقابلة للتنفيذ وفقًا للدراسات المتعلقة بالفيزياء والفضاء والجوانب والاحتياجات البشرية، فكرة المشروع مستوحاه من الحضارة المصرية القديمة بشكل عصرى  (توتيرا)

title.rendered: Prof Dr. Ashraf Abdel Mohsen has been selected as Space Architecture Ambassador

content.rendered: Prof Dr. Ashraf Abdel Mohsen has been selected by the Egyptian Space Agency as Space Architecture Ambassador. This program has been founded with the aim of raising awareness of the importance and benefits of space exploration and research in Egypt. One of the key objectives is to inspire and encourage students in Egypt to pursue careers in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics), and to provide information on the fantastic opportunities this field offers. This program will help the Egyptian Space Agency reach a wider audience, and bring hope for the future of spaceflight in Egypt.

TUTERA CITY – THE INVISIBLE CITY

توتيرا “TUTERA“:

هو آتجاه فكري معاصر يبحث عن جذور الحضارة المصرية القديمة في مجال التصميم العمراني والمعماري والفنون بكافة تخصصتها، يستكشف بذلك صحيح معانيها ورموزها ثم يُعيد صياغتها في ذات المجال تحت رؤية حداثية دون تقليد، هذا بما يتوافق مع متطلبات حاضر القرن الواحد والعشرين ويعكس أحلامه المستقبلية.

الرؤية:

طرح رؤية تصميمية معاصرة تعمل على إستكمال مسيرة الناتج المعماري والفني للحضارة المصرية القديمة بإعتبارها الجذور الأولى للحضارة الإنسانية التي نشأت على ضفتي وادي “النيل”، وذلك في إطار ذات القيم الحضارية ومعانيها ورموزها المستخدمة قديماً، وهذا بما يتوافق مع الرؤية الحداثية المعاصرة ويعكس بدوره الآمال المستقبلية.

الأهداف:

1- التصدي إلى محاولات إصباغ الناتج المعماري والفني للحضارة المصرية القديمة بصبغات إرهاصات فكرية بعيدة عنها، بل وتسئ إليها، وذلك بتطبيق صحيح المعاني والرموز المعمارية والفنية المستخدمة آنذاك ضمن تصميمات حداثية. 
2-  ترسيخ  توتيرا"TUTERA " كأتجاه فنى قادر على تكوين جيل جديد من المبدعين في مختلف مجالات الفنون والعمارة ، هذا الجيل قادر على تطوير مفرداته الإبداعية وتوريثها للأجيال التالية ضمن رؤية مستقبلية. 
3- تأصيل مفردات الهوية المصرية القديمة بإعتبارها أحد أهم محاور الشخصية والثقافة المصرية، والإستفادة من تفرد سماتها الحضارية في التسويق للمنتجات التي يتم تصميمها أو تأليفها أو تصنيعها ضمن الرؤية الفكرية الجديدة لتوتيرا "TUTERA".

رؤية المدينة:

بناء أول مدينة أبحاث علمية على أرض “مصر” تُخصص تطبيقاتها في مجال السياحة عبر حدود الزمان والمكان، إذ يتم وضع تصميمات ملامحها العمرانية والمعمارية والفنية بإعتبارها وثبة للدولة المصرية نحو المستقبل مروراً بجذورها التاريخية، وهي بذلك تُمثل أحد أهم أدوات الدولة للتسويق السياسي والإقتصادي والثقافي في خضم تحديات القرن 21.

جأت فكرة عمل مدينة جديدة عصرية بأنظمة حديثة تحمل جذور الحضارة المصرية وذلك عندما تخيل د.أشرف عبد المحسن بأن أجدادنا القدماء لازالوا مستمرين بحضاراتهم وتقدمت كثيرا فبأى مفهوم وبأى تكنولوجيا كانوا سيبنون تلك المدينة، الهرم لازال لغز يحير العالم باه الأمريكان كفندق فى التسعينات بمدينة لاس فيجاس بنفس تقريبا حجم هرم خوفو، والعديد من المحاولات لتقليد شكل الهرم وليس كمفهوم الاتصال بين الأرض والسماء كما بناه أجدادنا القدماء، من هنا جأت فكرة تطبيق الهرم كمعنى أصيل وغلاف لحياة أخرى بأبعاد غير مرئية

استخدام النسبة الذهبية بأبعاد المدينة وخلق مجموعة أهرامات (فراغات) متدرجة وصولا للهرم الزجاجى الذى يغطى منطقة مركز أبحاث علوم الفضاء ومنطقة التدريب تحت الأرض، وتواجد المدينة بين القشرة الخارجية والهرم الداخلى بعمق حوالى 200 م بكامل أضلاع الهرم يجعلها غير مرئية سواء من الداخل أو من الخارج ( المدينة الخفية) وتتكون من عدد 8 أحياء سكنية فندقية وترفيهية وغيرها من الأنشطة السياحية.

الهدف من إنشاء المدينة:

  1. تدشين أحدث مركز بحثي متخصص في مجال تكنولوجيا المستقبل وتطبيقات علوم الفلك والفضاء، وتفعيل تلك التطبيقات والتكنولوجيا في إستحداث نمط جديد للسياحة يتجاوز معها حدود المكان والزمان بما يحقق أعلى عائد إقتصادي.

  2. وضع أساس تجمع عمراني كثيف يُجسد الجذور التاريخية للدولة المصرية ويعبر في ذات الوقت عن ملامح مستقبلها القريب، وهو ما يعكس بدوره أحد أهم أدوات الدولة المصرية في التعبير عن ذاتها وماضيها العريق وأحلامها المستقبلية.

الفكرة التصميمة:

تقوم المدينة على كونها مدينة سياحية من طراز عالمي وما يجعلها مدينة فريدة من نوعها هو كونها أول مدينة تقوم على سياحة الفضاء الخارجي، جاء الفكر التخطيطي للمدينة قائماً على خلق محاور رئيسية تصل إلى مركز المدينة ومبناها الرئيسي وتتعامد هذه المحاور مع الإتجاهات الأصلية الأربعة في إشارة لكون قدماء المصريين هم من أوائل من عملوا بالفلك وفهموه وإستعرضوا علمهم وقوتهم في عمارتهم. على محاور المدينة الرئيسية تصطف مجموعة من المباني متعددة الإستعمالات تقف في إصطفاف تمهيداً للمبنى الرئيسي في مركز المدينة وهو مبنى ذو شكل هرمي مسيطر ويحتوي المبنى الرئيسي في وسط المدينة على أكبر مركز أبحاث ودراسات علوم فضاء وفلك في العالم مع إحتواءه على خدمات فندقية وترفيهية وسكنية حيث يتم أخذ الزائر في رحلة للعصور المصرية القديمة بكل ما تمثله من علوم ،أخلاق ،فن وعمارة.

كما تحتوي المدينة على منطقة سياحية فندقية مطلة على الشواطيء المحيطة بالإضافة إلى قرية سكنية متكاملة -بكل خدماتها- للعاملين في المدينة.

يقوم فكر المدينة على كونها مدينة مكتفية ذاتياً فتم إنشاء منطقة صوب زراعية بمساحة 2,600 فدان لتوفر إحتياجات المدينة كما تم إقتراح منطقة ألواح شمسية في الظهير الصحراوي للمدينة لتقوم بتغذية المدينة بالطاقة بالكامل دون الحاجة لمحطات طاقة خارجية كما تم إقتراح منطقة محطات تحلية ومعالجة مياه لتوفير المياه اللازمة لاحتياجات المدينة والزراعة.

جاء تصميم البناء الرئيسي بالشكل الهرمي تعبيراً عن قوة حضارتنا وإرثنا مستوحى من أعظم بناء شيد في العصور القديمة وهو هرم  الملك خوفو بالجيزه وهو بذلك يُعد البناء الأمثل تشكيلياً ورمزياً للتعبير عن الصلّة الروحية بين الأرض والإنسان والسماء -كما تخيلها قدماء المصريين- متجاوزاً حدود الزمان والمكان، وعليها تم وضع تصميم الحيز العمراني للمدينة – بإعتبارها مركز للسياحة عبر الزمان والمكان – كتعبير أصيل عن الصلّة الوثيقة بين الإنسان والكون من حوله بداية من مهد تاريخ الحضارة الإنسانية على أرض “مصر” إلى مشارف مستقبلها القريب، وقد تمت صياغة الهيكل البنائي للمدينة في تشكيل هرمي ذو تكوين مزدوج متباين الحجم، هذا التكوين المزدوج عبارة عن نواة داخلية وقشرة خارجية في تتابع رأسي على ذات المركز والمحاور، حيث تُمثل النواة الهرم الداخلي الهيكل التفاعلي الذي يُجسد الجذور التاريخية، وتُمثل القشرة الهرم الخارجي الغطاء الديناميكي الذي يُمثل أفاق المستقبل، ومن خلال دمج الهرمين يتم التواصل الرمزي والبصري مع أطياف السماء. وهذا ما يحقق بدوره شخصية التشكيل العام للمدينة مع وظيفية حيزها العمراني والمعماري، وذلك بما تحتويه من مركز بحثي متخصص في تطبيقات علوم الفلك والفضاء إلى جانب خدمات للسياحة عبر الزمان والمكان.

فيظهر المبنى في شكله الهرمي وتقع المناطق السكنية بين القشره الخارجية والداخلية منه ( لذلك أطلقنا عليها المدينة الخفية) THE INVISIBLE CITY
المدينة بالكامل داخل الهرم والمقترح أن يبلغ طول ضلع قاعدته 1000 متر وإرتفاع يصل إلى 650 متر ليقترب من 4 أضعاف حجم هرم خوفو في إستحضار واضح لنسب وعظمتة  بطريقة عصرية حديثة بكافة التقنيات الرقمية والذكية المستحدثة والمتوقعة فى المستقبل.
يتصل المبنى الرئيسي بمحطات مطلة على البحر تتصل بمنصات إطلاق صواريخ تبعد حوالي ٢٥-٣٠ كم عن حدود المدينة بخليج السويس لتكون منصة إطلاق للصواريخ الخاصة بزيارة وسفر الفضاء الخارجي.
تقوم فكرة المدينة في مجملها على كونها مدينة متكاملة متخصصة في سياحة الفضاء الخادجي وفي علوم وأبحاث الفضاء بروح مصرية عصرية تأكيداً على قوة وعظمة حضارتنا وريادتنا في مجالات الفلك ،العلوم والعمارة.

مكونات المبنى الرئيسي (الهرم) – يتكون برنامج المبنى الرئيسي من:

  1. مركز أبحاث وعلوم فضاء تحت مستوى الأرض بمساحة اجمالية حوالى 30,000 م2 وعلى اتصال من خلال أنفاق الى محطات الإطلاق ومناصاتها.
  2. المدينة الخفية بين القشره الهرمية الخارجية والداخلية بعمق حوالى 200 م وتحوى عدد 10 أحياء سكنية فندقية بمساحة تتراوح بين 10 الى 15 فدان لكل حى
  3. كما تشمل عدد 3 أحياء ترفيهية تجارية وكافة الخدمات اللازمة للسكان بمساحة تتراوح بين 5 الى 7 فدان
  4. منطقة الاسكتشاف فى الجزء العلوى من الهرم وتتكون من معامل تحتوى على أحدث التلسكوبات وأقواها فى العالم لتكتشف المجره ومابعدها مع محاكاه للسياحة فى الفضاء.
  5. منطقة خدمات وإدارة المبنى والمدينة
  6. الهرم الداخلى بمساحة حوالى 60 فدان، ويمثل التجربة الروحانية من خلال ساحة العرض التقنى للكون وهى ساحة إحتفالات والهرم الزجاجى المركزى لاستقبال الزوار ومن خلاله يتم زيارة معالم المدينة الخفية ومركز الأبحاث تحت الأرض.
  7. قمة الهرم ومطعم سفينة الفضاء

content.rendered:
The Ancient Egyptian’s Golden Parade; Such an event is not only impressive, but also shines a light on all Egyptians’ hearts.

We here at CUBE are profoundly proud as are we all as a nation. This event marks the day this great country returned to its former glory once more. 2021 will be the turn of the century for Egypt’s history.

We’re sure the great kings and queens that were transported to The Great Museum in Fustat have restored their faith in us. Let’s prove to them their faith has not been misplaced.

The Royal Car Designed by: Mohamed Attia

Image created by Seif Ashraf
04.04.2021

content.rendered:
READY TO JOIN TUTERA?

TUTERA is a contemporary intellectual trend for a new generation of creators and designers from all over the world in various fields of arts and architecture to complement the Ancient Egyptian beauty & spirit in a way that fits today’s lifestyle and be relevant in today’s context. TUTERA seeks to restore the glory of Egypt as well as drawing international attention to Egypt, sensing a gap in the market for true luxurious products.

Based on the cultural heritage, TUTERA sets new trends and designs for the world in seven branches: architecture, urban design, furniture, fashion, jewelry, vehicle design, and film production. All designs are based on historical references of ancient Egypt, using the correct meanings, symbols, and architectural and art vocabulary of the ancient Egyptian civilization used at the time, as it is the first cradle and the original roots of civilization.

For the last three years TUTERA has been working not only on conceptual designs in all branches, but also on TUTERA style mega projects that have been already executed. Now.. It’s time to spread the word and start collaborating with all designers and creative people who are passionate about the idea of the completion of greatness and elegance of ancient Egyptian civilization …TUTERA the modern Egypt.

Therefore, we will soon be launching TUTERA digital platform to showcase various designs inspired by ancient Egypt in hopes of fostering creatives into blending our beloved heritage into their work.

Our Platform will take you in a whole new mysterious, fascinating experience. Designed as a virtual city called “TUT City” it will lead you to virtual marketplace, showrooms, events.. an entire virtual community hub displayed in a futuristic way, yet integrating the ancient Egyptian spirit. As a platform dedicated to showcasing designs inspired by ancient Egypt, we are committed to guaranteeing optimum visibility and development opportunities to our creatives. If you are looking to showcase your conceptual designs, we will provide you with the space to do so. If you are looking to develop a unique design inspired by ancient Egypt, we will help connect you with your ideal designer. Or, if you are simply seeking to gather creative inspiration for your next design, TUTERA will guide you through their latest projects as well as other marvelous works from across the globe.

Throughout this year TUTERA will reveal booming TUTERA buildings, hold various events exhibiting their and all collaborators products, disclose research projects by expertise in the field and inspire you with different scientific papers, books and articles.

We are based in Cairo, Egypt, founded by Cube Consultants an Egyptian architectural consultancy firm.

Stay tuned for some links to help you get started on our website http://www.tutera.co !
Request a meeting with TUTERA team via info@tutera.co

Follow us on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/tutera.egypt/

Follow us on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/tutera.egypt

Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/Tutera_Egypt

Follow our page on Linkedin www.linkedin.com/company/tutera-egypt

Subscribe to our YouTube channel  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdtlNubz3nZDajNCK4jnDiw

title.rendered: In CUBE, A new day means new beauty.

content.rendered:
Everything around us is changing, Life is progressing so fast, and Technology is being uplifted every day to a higher and smarter level. & Actually, SO We Are…

We uplift ourselves to higher levels too, but that of the original smart human states of being… through living with the spirit of natural beauty & enjoying the art of being ourselves. We’re intuitively directed by the pure nature’s act, as being the greatest teacher and receiver of all, towards a truthful fulfillment of this real imaginary beauty; aiming to fill the whole world with.

We appreciate this unlimited number of new lives that we’re all gifted out of these new breaths, as a very uniquely designed bliss. It allows us to create many forms of art with great passion, with a lot of care and responsibility too; working upon our vision and applying our mission, to show out in real terms of actions what’s beyond imagination, and how we can beautifully change the world through new visions, approaches, and smart technologies.

It’s all about Our integrated “Mind” and “Soul”, It’s our greatest wealth. We heartfully insist on creating beauty-originated perceptions on different mindful levels through our continuous architectural speech, a speech to & from Earth, pointing out to a true invitation to each and everyone out there; to think about their true creative selves and their great capabilities of being… to realize the appropriate usage to their hidden powers. Let’s increase the freed-up minds to pave a new road of fruitful change for how better we all want the world to be.

With great Faith, Consistency and Persistence; We keep heading to an upper forward.

We realize by each step we take our true role on Earth.

We Imagine and Create because we believe…

We Design and Implement, because we insist on living a better life…

We Develop and Expand because we still have a lot to share…

CUBE…

Towards a world full of Art through Love, Beauty, and Peace.

 

Nohier Ahmed El-Samny

Initiatives & BIM Manager

content.rendered:
ANGELS OF MERCY

By: Ashraf Abdel Mohsen

15/11/2008

I can almost hear the Creator of the universe calling his creations:

You are blind to the truth of your life, because you choose not to seek the truth, which is based on peace and beauty.  You would rather choose to live in ignorance and have chosen a life that is transformed into chaos,. based on hatred, greed, lust and selfishness. He calls you to look for the truth, to find the beauty, magic and mystery of life;

No insincerity or dishonesty and no fear or humiliation. Humans were not created for depravity and immorality. On the contrary, humans were created to be ethical and moral; to be loyal, honest, full of pride and dignity, to be safe, sincere and strong. Your strength lies in your support of the poor and needy, in your patience and anticipation of failures, your rejection of all corruption and evil.

You have been created with qualities of spirituality and sensitivity, so that you can feel nature’s beauty and understand its depth and diversity to guide you through this life. Yet these are invisible to you, as you choose not to see them.

You are the most favoured of all God’s creations. He has always been there for you, to protect you, even from yourself, to listen to you and try to guide you. Do not block your own path, but open your heart so you can be open to spiritual insight. He has faith in you, so you too must have faith in your Almighty creator.

Lift up your eyes to the sky and your inner soul. Be a survivor, diligent, and active. Praise and fulfill your soul with spirit and belief. Observe the skies, the evolution of the stars, planets, galaxies, etc.  All move freely without borders, breathe, worship and praise in love God’s gift of life, his manifestation of heaven on earth.

Keep on sailing through the depth of the sky, discover the magnificence of this beautiful world, the power of the Almighty God who created it and the mystery behind its endless, eternal evolution. See the rainbow of colours in heaven. They change as the angels praise with pleasure and joy, confident and at peace in their faith and glory. Dear Friend, this world has been created for you and you are a part of the universe and, every creature in it, is also a part of you.  It is there for you to see, to explore in order to discover its Creator. Open your heart, your soul and find insight. With sincerity, you can find the splendor and majesty, the sweet mercy, justice, the grace, the love, etc…so much more than you have been looking for.

Dear friend, try to rise above the material and physical world around you and unearth the spiritual world. Open your senses, trust and have faith. Grow and strengthen your inner spirit and you will find the perfection of the Creator’s manifestation reflected in everything around you, no matter how small it may seem to you. Even the smallest things reveal the endless, infinite, eternal world.

Feel the tree, standing tall, still and proud. The tree shows us a whole complete world, a universe with its growth, breathing, feeding and survival. It is created for you to find amazement and knowledge of creation and the Creator, to open your eyes, to feed you, to give you a message to find your way through the spirit of nature.

Move with a drop of water, a life sustaining liquid from the great Creator. It is found all over the world. That transparent drop is an essential element of life, which all life needs on a daily basis…Why and How? It is for you, in order to eat and grow… in order to realize its benefits and the magic of its creator.

Look at your body, at yourself, your soul… a dynamic and vital combination of a precise chemistry and scientific processes. How are you born? How do you grow? How you use all your senses; talk, see, hear, eat, think, cry, laugh, decide, and work, etc…how many other functions are you able to perform that your mind is unable to recognize, understand or comprehend in its perfect wisdom. It is life with both its difficult and peaceful times, its good and evil… such a balance of contrasts that maintains the balance of creation within its perfection.

Touch your heart, the key component of life and emotions, how to love and hate… how to live and die… it’s your heart, which has been created for love “the greatest gift from God” and your most important responsibility is to use it to give love everywhere. Have you ever seen this? Perhaps not…Therefore, just love everyone, love everything around you. An infinite love is present within your heart, which, although it seems small, is huge with that which it holds.

 

Nevertheless, the more you live with love in your heart, the more you will be drawn towards the creator of this universe…appreciating the gift of life with all its challenges and gifts. Thoughtfully, try to be insightful of all of the miracles from God, the manifestation of the great Ceator’s will.

content.rendered:
TUTERA is a creative community hub for designers from all over the world to present designs reviving the Ancient Egyptian beauty and spirit in a way that fits today’s lifestyle and be relevant in today’s context. TUTERA seeks to bring true luxury back to Egypt as drawing international attention to Egypt, sensing a gap in the market for true lavish products. TUTERA captures the imagination with ultimate timeless and inspiring masterpiece designs that both us and customers find true pride in.

TUTERA aims to bring us back to the future with a new found perspective in the means of design taste and cultural pride. Egypt was once of the wealthiest kingdoms of the world filled with glamour and glory in every way. Egyptians need to retrieve their ethnic pride in a beautiful artistic fashion. Ancient Egyptian style is globally acknowledged and valued tremendously.

Founded by Cube Consultants, TUTERA began to subtly shine within the architectural and interior designs of their work incorporated in the slightest yet most effective details. But it does not stop here, TUTERA is meant for any type of design in architecture, interior, furniture, jewelry, fashion, apparel, automotive, film, music or any means of expression in art. This is our way of redefining and reviving our Ancient Egyptian heritage and pride. This is bringing our Ancient Egyptian taste and spirit back into the future.

We aim to revive the glory of Ancient Egypt.
We are based in Cairo, founded by Cube Consultants.

Talie Ashraf Abdel Mohsen

Marketing Executive

content.rendered:
King Khufu Axis or Road

The Giza Vision 2030, which was prepared by Cube Company in 2010 for the Ministry of Housing and the General Authority for Urban Planning, depends on restoring civilized life to archaeological and historical areas and investing their existence for the benefit of citizens by re-planning unplanned and random areas in a manner befitting the dignity of the Egyptian citizen and providing all necessary services such as schools, hospitals, clubs, commercial and cultural services and others, while developing the infrastructure, roads and transportation in those areas
King Khufu Axis is one of these giant projects to develop Cairo. The main title of this great dream is that in 2030 we will be able to clearly see the immortal pyramids from Sphinx Square in Mohandessin from a distance of 10 km. The project will serve “the monorail train that will connect Sphinx Square in Mohandessin to the Giza Pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum, and it will thus be one of the largest roads in the world, even the greatest, due to its historical and miraculous grandeur with the pyramids in front of it
The axis passes through unplanned areas that suffer from a lack of the necessary services to provide the required quality of life For its residents, such as the Bulaq Al-Dakrour area, Saft El-Laban and some areas of the pyramids, and implementing such a development axis will work to develop and advance not only those areas but Giza as a whole

: It was proposed within a vision and re-planning to upgrade Giza and the area surrounding the pyramids, the goals of which are summarized in
Investing in the components of the place as a global tourist and entertainment attraction ◼
Opening a developmental and visual traffic axis for the pyramids area to be a global commercial and tourist axis ◼
Linking the Pyramids Plateau to the Grand Egyptian Museum and developing the area surrounding the Pyramids Plateau to become an open museum for the whole world ◼
Infrastructure networks and a modern road and transportation network linking the city to Greater Cairo ◼
Giza is a green city friendly to the environment and people by providing citizens with a quality of life according to international standards ◼
Transforming Giza into a planned city according to international standards and a global tourist destination ◼
Reducing the spread of slums and encroachment on agricultural lands and the Giza Plateau ◼

The main components of the project to re-plan the area surrounding the Giza Plateau. The project consists of:
GEM Hotels Area -1
GEM Plaza -2
Khufu Plaza & Oasis -3
Open Sphinx Museum -4
(Sphinx Village (New Nazlet El-Semman) Sphinx New Village -5
King Khufu Axis or Road with a length of 8 km and a width of 100 – 250 m
Khufu Avenue -6
The project will also serve the monorail train and will connect Sphinx Square in Mohandessin to the Giza Pyramids passing through Arab League Street and the new Khufu Axis for a distance of 10 km
Urban belt For Giza, it limits the expansion of agricultural lands by planning residential areas with the concept of providing a life that Giza residents deserve. Urban Belt -7
To view the full details of the vision through the following link

 

https://issuu.com/cube-egypt/docs/giza2030_vision-cube-04-12-2010 

 

In 2008, some studies and surveys and population surveys were conducted for the axis path by experts from the Urban Planning Authority at the Ministry of Housing, and the removal areas were determined along the axis path, and they were estimated at about 38,500 thousand housing units. The vision proposed alternatives for the affected citizens, which were as follows:

Financial compensation at the market price for the housing unit and land ◼
Receiving an alternative unit or land in one of the newly planned areas ◼
Moving to temporary housing provided by the state until the project is implemented and receiving alternative units in the same area ◼
The cost of the project was estimated at a total length of 8 km, including all compensation, facilities and constructions related to the project, at approximately 80 billion Egyptian pounds. In the event that the state adopts the proposed vision, detailed plans and demographic, social, environmental, tourism, economic and other studies will be made for all proposed projects through specialized expertise houses.
We believe that the vision of the King Khufu axis projects will restore dignity to the descendants and wealth of the king and may compete with the city of Giza is the largest tourist city in the world in light of the opening of the Grand Egyptian Museum. The project may contribute to increasing the number of international tourists several times the current number.

A dream that has been delayed for a long time, but we hope that it will be achieved, making it one of the greatest streets in the world due to its historical and miraculous grandeur.

https://cubeconsultants.org/portfolio/khufu-plaza/
